title: Xdrip+ isn't responding
body: I opened an issue back in May but it didn't come back around. Still getting xdrip+ isn't responding wait or close about every 30 seconds. It is working with my Dexcom G5, its just popping that annoying message up no matter what app I'm in. I was the current version from xdrip nightlies in May and have tracked the nightlies all the way through to the current one as of this issue date, but still no changes.

comments.body: Can you post a screenshot of the "annoying message"? What does it say? Can you describe your issue in more detail?

You would ask for a screenshot when I just took out a sensor last night and was going to start a new one today. Xdrip works for but isn't showing anything because of that. But here is the error.. the graph is just empty. That error will pop up not just in xdrip, but no matter where I am in any other app. And it does it about every 30 seconds to a minute 24/7/365.
Sorry, cannot help you without some detail information - problem still completely unclear (to me). Link does not work.

Copy that link into the browser. It doesn't work for me either clicking it from github page. I think github is modifying the link somehow. If you copy and paste into a browser it works. The graphic is all I can give though unless you tell me how to give you detailed diagnostic info. The graphic also isn't anything special.. it is just the xdrip app with a pop up window over the the top of it that says XDrip+ isn't responding, then there are words you can click on to Wait or Continue. The pop up is the standard Android hung app dialog box.
Try switching off all "battery optimizations" on your phone: 1) search for "battery" in your Androids settings and also check 2) under Apps/xdrip+

@getut If you still have trouble, please ask for support at https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5 or https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus.

If it is solved, please close this issue.

There is a thread on facebook that is related.  Adrian Lxm has made suggestions in that thread.     
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5/permalink/4713928492013942

@getut You still did not report your [environment](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/new?assignees=&labels=&template=bug-report.md).

I'm experienced the same issue with xDrip running on LineageOS 17.1 until reboot.

As you stated in your description, this is a duplicate:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1328
